ranked_issues.name: Other other complaints
ranked_issues.definition: other complaints that fit none of the specific other issues (General praise or general criticism with no specific feature, unrelated content, politics/boycott slogans, or no supported specific topic.)

ranked_issues.name: Excessive Ad Interruptions
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that ads are too frequent, long, loud, or interrupt listening, including ads appearing before or between songs.

ranked_issues.name: Other billing complaints
ranked_issues.definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

ranked_issues.name: Free-Tier Song Choice and Ordering
ranked_issues.definition: Free users are forced into shuffle or cannot choose specific songs, play tracks in order, or use a queue.

ranked_issues.name: Wrong Songs or Playback Controls
ranked_issues.definition: Playback ignores the selected song or user controls, such as playing different tracks or failing to skip or shuffle as requested.

ranked_issues.name: Free-Tier Playback Controls Restricted
ranked_issues.definition: Free users face limits on skipping, replaying, or seeking within songs, or cannot repeat tracks.

ranked_issues.name: Restricted Playback Controls
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that users cannot reliably choose and play specific songs or control playback with options such as skip, seek, repeat, or playing tracks in order.

ranked_issues.name: Update Removes Basic Features
ranked_issues.definition: Include complaints that recent app updates remove familiar features or make music streaming and basic listening worse.

ranked_issues.name: App Crashes or Won't Load
ranked_issues.definition: The app crashes, shuts down, or gets stuck on a launch or loading screen, preventing playback or continued use.

ranked_issues.name: False or Failed Network Connection
ranked_issues.definition: The app reports no connection or fails to access playback despite working internet, including when using particular network types.

ranked_issues.name: Other downloads complaints
ranked_issues.definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

ranked_issues.name: Other playback complaints
ranked_issues.definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

ranking_rule: priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity = severity_sum; ties by issue_id
